```{r setup}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(purrr)
library(knitr)

d <- readRDS("emocovid_sampleCurves.RDS")

# soglia per percentili: 0.5% e 99.5% calcolati sul pool di tutte le osservazioni
# (ogni riga = un prelievo di un soggetto in un dato tempo), per ciascuna misura
LOW_P  <- 0.005
HIGH_P <- 0.995

thresholds <- d %>%
  group_by(measureID) %>%
  summarise(
    low  = quantile(value, LOW_P,  na.rm = TRUE),
    high = quantile(value, HIGH_P, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

d2 <- d %>%
  left_join(thresholds, by = "measureID") %>%
  mutate(
    outlier = value < low | value > high,
    label   = ifelse(outlier, subjID, NA)
  )

measures <- sort(unique(d2$measureID))


feat2 <- d %>%
  group_by(subjID, measureID) %>%
  filter(n() >= 3) %>%
  summarise(score = max(value) - min(value), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(measureID) %>%
  mutate(rank = rank(-score, ties.method = "first")) %>%
  ungroup()
```

## Metodo

- Ogni misura, tutti i punti (soggetti x tempi), no struttura temporale
- Soglie ai percentili 0.5% / 99.5% per misura, scala originale
- Punti oltre soglia etichettati con subjID

```{r thresholds-table}
thresholds %>%
  mutate(across(c(low, high), ~round(.x, 3))) %>%
  kable(col.names = c("Misura", "Soglia bassa (0.5%)", "Soglia alta (99.5%)"))
```

```{r plot-function}
plot_measure <- function(m) {
  dd <- d2 %>% filter(measureID == m)
  thr <- thresholds %>% filter(measureID == m)

  ggplot(dd, aes(x = 1, y = value)) +
    geom_violin(fill = "grey90", color = "grey60", trim = TRUE, width = 1.2) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white", color = "grey30") +
    geom_jitter(aes(color = outlier), width = 0.15, alpha = 0.55, size = 1.6) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = thr$low,  linetype = "dashed", color = "firebrick") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = thr$high, linetype = "dashed", color = "firebrick") +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      aes(label = label), na.rm = TRUE, size = 3, color = "firebrick",
      max.overlaps = 30, seed = 1
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "grey40", `TRUE` = "firebrick"), guide = "none") +
    labs(
      title = m,
      subtitle = paste0("soglie: ", round(thr$low, 3), " — ", round(thr$high, 3)),
      x = NULL, y = "valore"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
}

outlier_table <- function(m) {
  d2 %>%
    filter(measureID == m, outlier) %>%
    arrange(desc(pmax(value - high, low - value, 0))) %>%
    transmute(subjID, time, value = round(value, 3),
              soglia_superata = ifelse(value > high, "sopra soglia alta", "sotto soglia bassa")) %>%
    as.data.frame()
}
```

```{r render-slides}
#| output: asis
for (m in measures) {
  cat("\n\n## ", m, "\n\n")
  
  tab <- outlier_table(m)
  
  if (nrow(tab) > 0) {
    cat(":::: {.columns}\n\n")
    
    cat("::: {.column width=\"70%\"}\n\n")
    print(plot_measure(m))
    cat("\n\n:::\n\n")
    
    cat("::: {.column width=\"30%\"}\n\n")
    cat("::: {style=\"font-size: 0.55em;\"}\n\n")
    print(kable(tab, row.names = FALSE,
                col.names = c("subjID", "tempo", "valore", "soglia superata")))
    cat("\n\n:::\n\n")
    cat(":::\n\n")
    
    cat("::::\n\n")
  } else {
    print(plot_measure(m))
    cat("\n\nNessun punto oltre soglia per questa misura.\n\n")
  }
}

## Riepilogo soggetti flaggati

```{r summary-table}
summary_tab <- d2 %>%
  filter(outlier) %>%
  group_by(subjID) %>%
  summarise(
    n_misure_flag = n_distinct(measureID),
    misure = paste(sort(unique(measureID)), collapse = ", "),
    n_punti_flag = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_misure_flag), desc(n_punti_flag))

summary_tab %>% kable(col.names = c("subjID", "N misure", "quali", "N punti"))
```

## Feature-based (range / jump normalizzati)

```{r feat-plot-function}
plot_feat <- function(m) {
  raw <- d %>% filter(measureID == m, subjID %in% (feat2 %>% filter(measureID == m) %>% pull(subjID)))
  fl  <- feat2 %>% filter(measureID == m, rank <= 3) %>% pull(subjID)
  raw <- raw %>% mutate(flagged = subjID %in% fl)
  lbl <- raw %>% filter(flagged) %>% group_by(subjID) %>% filter(value == max(value)) %>% slice(1) %>% ungroup()

  ggplot(raw, aes(time, value, group = subjID)) +
    geom_line(data = filter(raw, !flagged), color = "grey70", alpha = 0.4) +
    geom_point(data = filter(raw, !flagged), color = "grey70", alpha = 0.4, size = 0.8) +
    geom_line(data = filter(raw, flagged), color = "firebrick", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(data = filter(raw, flagged), color = "firebrick", size = 1.4) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = lbl, aes(label = subjID), color = "firebrick", size = 3, seed = 1) +
    labs(title = m, x = "tempo", y = "valore") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
}

score_table <- function(m) {
  feat2 %>%
    filter(measureID == m) %>%
    arrange(rank) %>%
    slice_head(n = 8) %>%
    transmute(subjID, score = round(score, 2)) %>%
    as.data.frame()
}
```

```{r feat-slides}
#| output: asis
for (m in measures) {
  cat("\n\n## ", m, " {.smaller}\n\n:::: {.columns}\n\n::: {.column width=\"70%\"}\n\n")
  print(plot_feat(m))
  cat("\n\n:::\n\n::: {.column width=\"30%\"}\n\n")
  print(kable(score_table(m), row.names = FALSE, col.names = c("subjID", "score")))
  cat("\n\n:::\n\n::::\n\n")
}
```
